The '''Anga system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Sarka sector/Legends|Sarka sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].

The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]] believed [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] had taken the [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]-frozen [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to the Anga system. While incarcerated in [[Keldabe/Legends|Keldabe]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], Dengar informed [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] of Solo's supposed whereabouts, though the information proved to be a false lead.
